description: This file defines classes and functions related to performance metrics logging, including metrics for plugin activation, suspension, and page load events within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: Metric
classes.description: A class for handling and formatting metric data, providing access to the data and its length.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuput
classes.description: Implements IStateMetricsLogger to log plugin state metrics such as activation, suspension, and memory usage.

classes.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser
classes.description: Implements IBrowserMetricsLogger to log browser-specific metrics including page load success, suspension, and memory usage.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuput::Enable
methods.description: Enables logging for a plugin, associating it with a service and retrieving memory info.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuput::Disable
methods.description: Disables logging and releases memory interface.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuput::Activated
methods.description: Logs plugin activation and memory resident size.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuput::Resumed
methods.description: Logs plugin resumed event and memory resident size.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuput::Suspended
methods.description: Logs plugin suspended event and memory resident size.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser::Suspended
methods.description: Logs browser suspension and memory resident size.

methods.name: MetricsTraceOuputBrowser::LoadFinished
methods.description: Logs page load completion, success status, and memory usage.
